tests: Fresh worlds, save validation and all eight job definitions are finite and bounded
Walking, jumping and diagonal movement use the same production movement physics
A deliberate flop creates constrained ragdoll joints and safely gets back up
Grabbing uses spring motion, throws preserve momentum, and lost job cargo returns to its pickup
Cars exchange crash momentum, separate, spin and take damage without creating energy
Loose objects exchange mass-weighted impulses and vehicles can knock them away
Car entry loads a held object and safe exit retains the cargo
Helicopter lift, boat thrust, boost energy and recovery are physical and finite
Purchases debit once, cannot overspend, and owned houses, hats, pets and ride calls persist
Collectible stars award once, cancel removes job cargo, and an expired job does not deduct cash
Normal walking and grab inputs complete Parcel Run and Pizza Express with real cargo
Normal walking, grab and drop inputs complete cleanup and material deliveries
Fishing requires reaching the pier, casting and reacting to three actual bite windows
Taxi pilot drives three physical fares using steering, throttle and ACT inputs
Island Rally passes all eight real checkpoint rings with normal steering and throttle
Coastal Rescue flies to the offshore island, lands, boards and returns a real passenger
